description: Statistics of rulings of Polish common courts in consumer credit disputes, published in the Court Rulings Portal of the Ministry of Justice and classified by finwire.pl: CHF mortgages (chf), loans in EUR and other currencies (waluta_inna), free credit sanction under art. 45 of the Consumer Credit Act (skd), cost refunds after early repayment, Lexitor (wczesniejsza_splata), WIBOR clauses (wibor), unit-linked policies (polisolokata). Returns rulings per publication month, share ruled for the borrower at least in part in 12 full publication months (finwire_borrower_win_share, total and per category), first vs second instance, median time from claim to judgment and the newest rulings with case number, court, outcome and a link to the full text. Statistics of published rulings, not legal advice; each ruling concerns one contract.
